source: ESPN public injury report and game summaries

injuries.name: Jordan Miller
injuries.short_comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.
injuries.long_comment: It's a tough break for Miller, who had an opportunity to battle for a reserve role during training camp in the fall. The timeline for a return is likely to keep him on the shelf until after the All-Star break. Miller's extended stay on the sidelines gives Kobe Sanders a chance to crack the Clippers' rotation.

injuries.name: Bradley Beal
injuries.short_comment: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.
injuries.long_comment: Beal is dealing with knee inflammation that will keep him sidelined for Opening Night. While it's unclear how long the Clippers will be without the veteran guard, Darius Garland, Keaton Wagler and Kris Dunn should dominate the backcourt minutes in his absence. Beal's 2025-26 campaign was cut short by a hip injury after he averaged 8.2 points and 1.7 assists in 20.6 minutes across just six regular-season appearances.

injuries.name: Dejounte Murray
injuries.short_comment: Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.
injuries.long_comment: This was the expectation after the star guard requested a trade from the Pelicans earlier Friday. Given his standing with the club, Murray can be tentatively considered doubtful for future contests while New Orleans tries to find him another home.

injuries.name: Trendon Watford
injuries.short_comment: Watford (ankle) is probable for Friday's game against the Clippers.
injuries.long_comment: Watford could be on the verge of making his return to the hardwood Friday after missing each of New Orleans' last nine games. However, he should be a depth option in the frontcourt and not much else when given the green light to return.

injuries.name: Bennedict Mathurin
injuries.short_comment: Mathurin (foot) is doubtful for Friday's game against the Clippers.
injuries.long_comment: Mathurin has been dealing with plantar fasciitis for quite some time and hasn't suited up in any of the Pelicans' last six games. The doubtful tag leaves the door open for a potential return, but it wouldn't be surprising if he remains sidelined. Mathurin is averaging just 5.5 points, 1.8 rebounds and 1.2 assists per game this season.

injuries.name: Julian Reese
injuries.short_comment: The Pelicans transferred Reese from the G League's Laketown Squadron, and he will be available for New Orleans' game against the Warriors on Monday.
injuries.long_comment: Reese dropped a 15-point, 15-rebound double-double in the Squadron's win over the Mexico City Capitanes on Saturday and will return to the parent club ahead of its game Monday. Through five regular-season appearances at the NBA level this season, the big man is averaging 1.2 points and 1.0 rebounds in 5.4 minutes per tilt.
